implementation: The IBM UltraCypher 2 Cryptographic Engine - Accelerator supported RSA
description: The IBM UltraCypher 2 Cryptographic Engine-Accelerator (i.e. CEX2A) supported RSA is a hybrid implementation for RSA Signature Verification. The RSA algorithm is architected and implemented in two layers: the top layer handles the PKCS#1 padding of the results; the bottom layer deals with the modulo arithmetic and exponentiation which is supported by CEX2A.CEX2A provides fast, ultrasecure, hardware-based arithmetic primitives.
version: HW 1.0 SW OA26457 (Hybrid of SW and HW)
